description: Download what a browser walk needs, once: the browser engine (Playwright, axe-core, Lighthouse) and the requested browsers (default: chromium). For chromium that is about 440 MB to download, about 730 MB on disk (measured on macOS arm64, varies by platform). Run this when a sniff tool returns `needsSetup: playwright-browsers`, then retry. It takes about a minute on a fast link; pass a progress token to get progress notifications.

projects.description: Browser projects to install. Defaults to ["chromium"].

name: sniff_install
